messages:
Lena Ortiz: Dropped two tiny mocks for the Project settings form. Pattern A: short inline errors under each field. Pattern B: micro badges on fields + a dismissible error banner at the top after submit. Also sketched a lightweight bulk-delete confirm (undo snackbar vs confirm-by-name). Looking for quick takes on clarity, mobile density, and a11y. Noah Reed: Quick skim 1: inline-under-field is immediate for single fixes. Banner helps when multiple sections fail. Concern: banner could be off-screen on mobile when keyboard shows. Tara Iyer: For tables, inline blocks eat vertical space. Consider tiny error pills on rows + one banner that expands to a list when failures >2. Banner must be expandable and focusable. Marta Gomez: Accessibility notes: banner must be announced and focus should move to it on submit failure. Suggest an assertive region and explicit aria-label. Example: ```
Save failed 1 issues. Expand for details.
``` Lena Ortiz: Good. Also wondering about required indicators 1: our comps use just an asterisk. Should we add the word "Required" on desktop and keep `aria-required` for mobile? Noah Reed: I prefer the explicit word for critical fields (billing/org name). Asterisk alone is ambiguous. On narrow screens hide it visually but keep aria attributes. Tara Iyer: Agreed. Also ensure invalid fields get `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby` pointing at the message. Don't rely on color alone. Marta Gomez: Delete confirmation notes: undo snackbar is nice for soft deletes. For irreversible org deletes prefer confirm-by-name. Typed-phrase is overkill in many cases; use it only for cross-account destructive actions. Lena Ortiz: DesignBot quick scan? DesignBot: Scan summary: Pattern A helper contrast = 3.6:1 (fail). Pattern B missing programmatic focus transfer on error submit. Recommendations: increase helper contrast to >=4.5:1 or use stronger weight; add `aria-label="Form errors"` to banner and call `.focus()` after render; ensure `aria-invalid` is set on invalid controls. Noah Reed: Action items: 1) bump helper text contrast or weight; 2) implement focus move to banner + focus first invalid input; 3) show explicit "Required" text for critical fields (keep * optional); 4) use confirm-by-name for org-level irreversible deletes, snackbar undo for soft bulk deletes. Lena Ortiz: I'll update the mocks and add copy options for confirm-by-name. Tagging @Tara for microcopy review. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
